integrity.exhaustiveness: All 455 vertex triples are tested; all 243 missing triangles are evaluated.
integrity.facet_data: All 87 tetrahedra are embedded in verify.py from the cited public data table.
integrity.fundamental_group_check: An explicit 24-point permutation representation satisfies all triangular relators and has image order 24; combined with the cited binary-tetrahedral topology this makes the representation faithful.
integrity.reproducibility: The bundled verifier is Python-standard-library only.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the exact labeled 15-vertex octahedron_space triangulation, not all triangulations of the same manifold.
Systolic length is edge count among simple cycles in the 1-skeleton.
Free-homotopy types are unoriented: conjugacy classes are identified with their inverse.
The 1999 dissertation is earlier bibliographic prior art but was not available as a day-resolved searchable full text for statement-level comparison.
title: Homology misses one of two triangular systole types in the 15-vertex octahedral space
